chunks: "The saving acts are feeding food, spreading salām, and salat (prayer) at night while the people are asleep."

key_terms.إِفْشَاءُ: spreading and making common among people
key_terms.اَلسَّلَامِ: salām; greeting of peace and goodwill
key_terms.اَلْمُنْجِيَاتُ: the acts that bring deliverance and salvation

ai.seo_question: What deeds did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe as bringing salvation?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام identifies deeds that lead to salvation: feeding others, spreading salām, and performing salat (prayer) at night. The hadith joins social generosity, communal goodwill, and private worship as means of spiritual success.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1719 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The acts that bring salvation are feeding the hungry, spreading peace, and praying at night while people are asleep."
